requirement: Every NEW file explicitly saved to personal ChatGPT Library must be routed to its actual owner workstream folder BEFORE upload. A chat download, filesystem write or Git commit alone is NOT a Library save.
applies_to: new generated reports, scripts, checkpoints, content ZIPs, source ledgers and workstream tools
general new Library uploads executed by an agent
precedence: explicit user destination if safe and writable
workflow: Determine actual owning workstream, not keyword-only title. Distinguish Menschen-A1 from Menschen-A1-Verben and A2 from A2-Verben.
Resolve explicit registered destination, file role, final basename before creating or saving a user Library artifact.

If project owner or destination is ambiguous, BLOCK and seek source/owner rather than uploading to /Flasch kart, general Current, Checkpoints, Final, 00-Unclassified or arbitrary intermediate location.
Check destination folder; create missing role subfolder with files.manage_library.create_folder, or BLOCK on failure.
Upload original exact bytes ONCE via files.manage_library.upload with explicit destination_path and overwrite=false; use container_path for new local artifacts or exact exported source_file_ref.
Read back files.list or files.search to verify actual destination full path, library_file_id, and required content SHA. A successful upload call alone is not VERIFIED.
Persist verified path, stable ID and SHA in handoff/receipt; keep existing historical references and immutable lineage intact.
On failure, retain original bytes in chat/container, mark LIBRARY_SAVE_BLOCKED and provide honest delivery link. Never silently use a different Library path.
Do not claim platform's implicit auto-save routing can be controlled by these project scripts. This contract governs explicit tool-initiated Library writes only.
legacy_exception: Old Project-backed Library artifacts may return project_library_mutation_unsupported; do not copy-delete/move or imply cleanup. Historical cleanup is a distinct approved process.
stage_boundary: Organization has NO authority to promote content Stage4/5/6/7, runtime CURRENT, UI, SRS, LOCKED or security grants.

verification_pilot.implication: Do not claim reliable direct save or that automatic ChatGPT Library root saves are reconfigured until exact destination upload and readback succeed.
